title_ru: ДУША ЯНУСА — компилятор заднего ума: прошлое -> доказанные запреты -> будущие обязательства
title_en: JANUS SOUL — Hindsight Obligation Compiler: Past -> Proven Guards -> Future Obligations

cultural_inspiration.source_basis: User-supplied South Park summary in the design conversation.
cultural_inspiration.semantic_translation: The useful part is not retrospective mockery; it is exact reconstruction of which earlier decision allowed a later failure, followed by a proof-bounded guard that prevents recurrence.
cultural_inspiration.copyright_boundary: Only the abstract hindsight archetype is used as engineering inspiration; no episode text, dialogue, images, or character likeness is required by the algorithm.

armor_of_god_precedent.pattern: METAPHOR -> HARD_DISTINCTIONS -> INVARIANTS -> PIPELINE -> RED_TEAM -> CLAIM_CEILING
armor_of_god_precedent.translation: The Soul inherits the same anti-self-deception structure: memory may guide attention and candidate design, but only independently replayable proof may authorize theorem claims.

core_equations.failure_extraction: VERIFY(tau) AND DERIVE(tau -> mechanism m) -> FAILURE_RECEIPT(m)
core_equations.runtime_use: G_m(S,a)=true -> REJECT_KNOWN_BAD; G_m(S,a)=false -> NOT_KNOWN_BAD, never SAFE_BY_DEFAULT
core_equations.target_bridge: POLY_FIND + POLY_HOLD + POLY_ADVANCE + EXACTNESS_CERTIFICATION + DEBT_RESOURCE_ACCOUNTING + TERMINAL_CORRECTNESS -> SAT_IN_P -> P=NP

LEARNING_FACE.role: Look backward across append-only verified history; extract failures; propose generalizations; generate candidate guards; attack them with counterexamples.
LEARNING_FACE.output: reviewed candidate law/guard set plus exact provenance

THEOREM_FACE.role: Execute one finite frozen deterministic algorithm snapshot against a new arbitrary CNF.
THEOREM_FACE.theorem_authority: only after independent proof/replay release gates

uniformity_firewall.reason: An ever-growing instance-indexed archive can hide non-uniform advice or precomputation and therefore cannot be treated as a free polynomial-time algorithm.
theorem_mode_requirement: The compiled hindsight guard set is finite and frozen before the input is seen, OR
for input length N, every input-dependent guard family is generated uniformly by one fixed algorithm in polynomial time and polynomial space in N.
forbidden: lookup of a pre-solved answer for the current CNF
unpriced table covering exponentially many instances
post-hoc addition of a new guard after theorem-mode OPEN
semantic oracle disguised as historical similarity

POLY_FIND.user_seed: Look into the past to understand the future.
POLY_FIND.formal_translation: Use proved historical failure guards to remove actions or regions that are already known to reproduce a certified failure mechanism.
POLY_FIND.what_it_can_prove: A guard may prove that some candidates are forbidden.
POLY_FIND.what_it_cannot_prove_alone: It does not prove that at least one useful exact action always remains or that the remaining action is discoverable in polynomial total work.
POLY_FIND.statement: For every reachable nonterminal theorem-state S, polynomial-time guard evaluation plus canonical candidate enumeration leaves and finds at least one exact useful action a within one original-N polynomial budget.

POLY_HOLD.formal_translation: State, representations, certificates, guard evaluation, indexes, summaries, and all per-instance hindsight data remain inside one fixed B(N)=N^c envelope.
POLY_HOLD.special_firewall: The global life-history of JANUS is development provenance; it is not free per-instance theorem memory.

POLY_ADVANCE.formal_translation: Forbid trajectories that keep moving while never getting closer to a terminal decision.

hotel_california_firewall.name: NO_HOTEL_CALIFORNIA
rules: RETURN_TO_PREVIOUS_RANK_OR_STATE_CLASS -> REJECT unless a separately proved bounded normalization phase permits it
A macrostep commits only if an exact rank mu strictly decreases
The initial rank range and every normalization phase must themselves be polynomially bounded in original N
hotel_california_firewall.key_distinction: A strictly changing state sequence can still be an infinite/exponential trap; progress requires a polynomially bounded well-founded measure, not novelty.

EXACTNESS_CERTIFICATION.formal_translation: Every failure receipt, generalized guard, committed transition, rank decrease, terminal decision, and resource claim has an independently replayable certificate.
EXACTNESS_CERTIFICATION.hindsight_rule: A historical lesson without a checker is advisory memory only.

DEBT_RESOURCE_ACCOUNTING.formal_translation: Charge failed proposals, guard matching, generalization checks, indexes, history summaries, representation changes, normalization, recovery, proof bytes and verifier work.
DEBT_RESOURCE_ACCOUNTING.hindsight_rule: Remembering a lesson is not free if retrieving or matching that lesson costs superpolynomial work.

guard_authority_levels.L0_ADVISORY_PATTERN: Similarity or heuristic pattern. May prioritize tests only.
guard_authority_levels.L1_EXACT_REPLAY_GUARD: Exact state/action digest pair is known to reproduce a verified failure; may reject only that exact pair.
guard_authority_levels.L2_STRUCTURAL_GUARD: A syntactic class implication is independently proved and polynomially recognized.
guard_authority_levels.L3_THEOREM_GUARD: A universal guard is part of a released proof-authorized theorem machine.

survivor_to_executable_obligation_matrix.attack: construct reachable states where all known historical guards are irrelevant or where remaining candidate discovery is exponential
survivor_to_executable_obligation_matrix.pass_requires: one frozen polynomial search procedure finds a certified useful action for every reachable nonterminal state

survivor_to_executable_obligation_matrix.attack: force guard/index/representation/certificate growth across the trajectory
survivor_to_executable_obligation_matrix.pass_requires: all charged bytes and work stay within one original-N polynomial envelope

survivor_to_executable_obligation_matrix.attack: cycle, long normalization chain, exponentially large potential, or state novelty without terminal approach
survivor_to_executable_obligation_matrix.pass_requires: strict well-founded descent with polynomial initial range and polynomial micro/macro step bounds
independent verifier deterministically rejects every tampered artifact

survivor_to_executable_obligation_matrix.attack: hide work in indexing, memory retrieval, generalization, failed proposals, normalization or recovery
survivor_to_executable_obligation_matrix.pass_requires: ledger charges all work and bytes to original N

runtime_contract.safe_initial_scope: Exact-digest historical failure guards, deterministic digesting, bounded debt accounting, and Hotel-California rank checks.
runtime_contract.important_non_feature: v1 does not generalize from one historical failure to a structural class without an external proof receipt.

scientific_boundary.interpretation: This artifact converts the hindsight metaphor into a sound candidate learning/proof discipline. It narrows the next theorem obligations but is not itself a P=NP proof.
